Establish country priorities across the portfolio, balancing short-term business delivery with long-term portfolio development and organizational sustainability. Ensure timely escalation of material business, operational, legal, compliance or reputational risks. Lead the development and execution of business plans, forecasts and resource allocation decisions. Monitor sales performance, market dynamics, portfolio contribution, operating expenses and relevant financial indicators. Manage budgets within approved targets and communicate key business assumptions, risks and opportunities transparently. Drive disciplined execution that balances business delivery, compliance requirements and long-term organizational interests. Oversee distributor and partner performance, where applicable, and ensure proper governance of commercial relationships. Portfolio and Commercial Leadership Lead the Belarus portfolio strategy, including brand priorities, launch readiness and lifecycle management for relevant products. Ensure that commercial plans are based on a sound understanding of patient needs, healthcare system priorities, customer insights, competitive dynamics and access conditions. Ensure effective coordination between commercial strategy, medical priorities, regulatory pathways, market access objectives, supply requirements and external engagement. Build sustainable relationships with customers, institutions and business partners in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements. Market Access and External Environment Lead country input into market access priorities by maintaining a clear view of Belarus funding mechanisms, procurement processes, access pathways and relevant policy developments. Represent the company in relevant external interactions within the formally delegated scope of authority. Maintain effective local governance and ensure appropriate financial, legal, regulatory, employment, operational and compliance controls are in place. Promote a strong culture of integrity, ethical decision-making and personal accountability. Partner closely with Legal, OEC/Compliance, Finance, HR, Regulatory and other supporting functions to identify and manage country-level risks. Ensure that material decisions and activities follow the required review, approval and documentation processes. Cross-Functional Integration Lead country planning forums and align functional priorities around a single Belarus agenda. Clarify ownership, decision rights and expected outcomes across local and cluster-based teams. Ensure effective collaboration between employees based in Belarus and functions supporting Belarus from other locations. Ensure timely resolution of cross-functional issues and barriers to execution. Support talent development, succession planning and retention of critical capabilities. Significant leadership experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare or another highly regulated industry. Demonstrated experience in leading a business, country operation, business unit or substantial cross-functional organization. Strong understanding of commercial strategy, portfolio management, financial planning and performance management. Experience working with market access, regulatory, medical, legal, compliance and supply chain functions. Fluent Russian and professional working proficiency in English. Enterprise leadership; strategic and systems thinking; business and financial acumen; ethical judgment; cross-functional integration; external stakeholder management; risk-based decision-making; executive communication; people leadership; resilience and adaptability.
